approval_policy.description: Approval policy for ACME Bonsai Chief of Staff team

publish_briefing.notes: Routine briefings: River may auto-publish during the delegation window if no edit is required.

publish_initiative_color_change.notes: Initiative health color is set by the sponsor; River verifies but does not override.

external_communication.notes: Any communication to external stakeholders (investors, banks, regulators) requires explicit CEO approval.

delegation_window.notes: Jane may grant River a defined window of delegation authority for routine briefing publication.

agent_restart_or_pause.notes: Magpie surfaces anomalies; restart/pause of any agent requires CEO approval.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop can be activated immediately by River or Jane.
